final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN fielding AS f ON f.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count, AVG(player_count) AS average_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT h.batting_hand, h.player_count, 1.0 * h.player_count / t.total_count AS share, h.player_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM hand_counts AS h CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE h.player_count > t.average_count
